message: No detected input validation: The code loads images and labels directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, value-range guards, or structural validation on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local directory path and VGG16 weights are fetched via Keras without any checksum verification, pinned revision, or authentication of the remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code performs one-hot encoding and label binarization but never validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline only loads, resizes, channel-swaps, and normalizes images with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The VGG16 pretrained weights are loaded directly via `VGG16(weights='imagenet', ...)` with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the integrity of the downloaded weights.

No detected label distribution validation: The code performs one-hot encoding and a stratified train/test split but never checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop or surrounding code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard Keras/TensorFlow Adam optimizer with no DP-SGD, Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or any other differential privacy mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads images, resizes them, and scales pixel values but performs no validation of input shape, range checks, or rejection of malformed/adversarial inputs before passing data to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The evaluation code applies argmax to predictions but performs no probability sanity checks, NaN guards, or threshold validation on the model's output probabilities before using them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a CNN-based image classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
